samples.body: Loading an empty YAML file returned None and crashed later. Fixes #101.
samples.author: dana-c
samples.diff:

+++ b/src/app/config.py
@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@ def load(path):

+    if data is None:
+        return {}
     return data
